title: nxnative's games
description: Every game nxnative has a profile for at the commit Cartouche pins, written by catalog/tools/nxnative_games.py from nxnative's dm/games. Names and facts about the profiles only: never where to get a game.

nxnative.description: The nxnative commit the list was read from (catalog/nxnative.commit).

name.description: The name nxnative gives the game's app.

genre.description: From the profile's App Store category; other for a plain games category.

status.description: Where nxnative says it plays the game: on the iPhone (and the Mac), on the Mac, still in bring-up, or unknown when nothing says. Read from the opening paragraphs of the game's notes (README.md), which are kept up to date, else from the profile's opening comment.

build.description: The version of the game the profile is for.

variants.description: Releases for other regions, each with its own profile.
